description.value: (Created by the Sentry Turret Gadgeteer Gadget)

As a Utilize action, you can deploy this collapsible device in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of yourself, where it unfolds into a Small, stationary blaster turret. You can recover the turret as a Utilize action.
The turret has AC 15 and Hit Points equal to three times your Gadgeteer level, and it has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Reducing the turret to 0 Hit Points destroys it.

When an enemy moves within 60 feet of the turret, you can take a Reaction to command the turret to fire. Make a ranged attack roll using your Intelligence. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** Radiant damage.
